entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit... We don't have time to be doin'[n]crap like this...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You don't need to keep mentioning it.[n]We're doing this to keep suspicions off[n]of us, remember?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: "Goro Akechi"...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This one too. "Akechi."

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: They're mostly the same over here[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Everyone's so eloquent when they can[n]be anonymous.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's like they never accepted us[n]to begin with...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It would be nice if you did some work[n]too, Ryuji-kun. You came to help us[n]count these, right?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Come on Leader, can you tell him too?
Take this seriously.
Just relax, Ryuji.
I'm actually tired...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're gatherin' information too. Y'know,[n]like, online and stuff.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess that's one way of saying it...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Aren't you taking this a little too lightly?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You too?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa, look here... This ain't good...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: "Criminal profiling"?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The acts of thievery committed by the[n]Phantom Thieves are mere fakes.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And their true goal is... murder!? Every[n]heart they changed before Okumura[n]was just a warm-up!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *sigh* So now they're accusing us of[n]being a bunch of killers...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This is so effin' stupid! Dammit!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We have the results.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: First place is Goro Akechi.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What!? Akechi!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What're you so surprised for? We've been[n]mentioning him this whole time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Seriously? Not some singer or an idol?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's because of us that his popularity[n]has skyrocketed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're the ones countin' the results![n]Can't we just make 'em up? We don't[n]hafta get him...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: People will figure that out. He won by[n]a landslide...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I knew people would vote for him, but[n]this is way more votes than I was[n]expecting.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It would be best for us to avoid inviting[n]such a clear danger upon ourselves...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like a little more time to think about[n]who to ask...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That reminds me... how is Futaba-chan[n]doing?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: She seemed like she was looking into[n]something on her own... Has she told[n]you anything?
Not a word.
I'm worried...
Let's leave it to her.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's not that I don't trust her, but...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You haven't heard from her? I wonder if[n]she's okay...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're not gonna get arrested 'cause[n]the police tracked her down, right?[n]That's the last thing we need now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even one clue would work wonders[n]for us. We should let her continue[n]with her own investigation.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I hope she finds something...
